source_freshness: Freshly retrieved export; individual notices may be undated or old. Retrieval is not a closure confirmation.

crosswalk_summary.approach: Keep current Mapbox IDs and properties. Proposed one-to-one links require >=99% reciprocal line coverage within3m. Treat subsets, splits, and new records separately. Folder/name keys and ordinal snapshot keys are not stable upstream IDs. Freeze reviewed geometry fingerprints and explicit lineage in a future maintained crosswalk; do not infer deletion from missing names.

decisions_to_resolve.question: Should the seven largely missing official road-walk records be added as distinctly styled route connections, preserving all existing off-road RT?
decisions_to_resolve.note: Includes the Ivy construction detour; adding geometry should not imply permanent status or ordinary off-road trail access.

decisions_to_resolve.question: Keep the two source-labeled closed lines excluded from navigable additions, and investigate status before any closure annotation?
decisions_to_resolve.note: Sandridge–Old Ivy description says until2027; RiverNorth closure has no dated description. Existing65features are retained.

decisions_to_resolve.question: Reconcile December2025 closure/temporary detour metadata with the September2026 work-party reference before changing navigation status.
decisions_to_resolve.note: The three Fontaine geometries are already fully covered by current RT; this is an access/route-role question, not a missing-geometry task.

independent_official_sources.finding: RTF identifies its Google map as official and warns the printable PDF may lag it.

RTF work-party event describes maintenance of a new Fontaine–Stribling segment and Forestry loop. This is newer than the KML December2025 closure text, but does not prove every construction area is reopened.
Belvedere Neighborhood Update describes a construction reroute and closed older segment. This supports historical route context; the old date cannot confirm November2026 access status.
Old Ivy Residences planning report discusses retaining/rerouting Rivanna access and uncertainty about construction closure phasing. It does not independently confirm the KML until2027 closure.
